$comment: Pinned Godot toolchain for the Scoundrel web-room trial (docs/plans/godot-plan.md, 'Godot web feasibility and version policy'). Never follow a moving 'stable' download: scripts/export-godot.mjs downloads exactly these URLs and verifies the SHA-512 sums from the release's official SHA512-SUMS.txt before extraction. Checksums were fetched from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/SHA512-SUMS.txt on 2026-09-30. If the pinned version ever changes, re-verify every field against the release archive and update docs/plans/godot-phase0-baseline.md.

source.$comment: The stripped web template is built from the engine source cloned at this exact commit (scripts/build-stripped-template.sh provisions it and verifies HEAD == commit; a moved tag or stale cache fails the build instead of shipping different engine code). Commit resolved from the tag via git ls-remote on 2026-10-04.
